newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle trade slow at $67 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle trade slow at $67 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow. Slaughter steers and heifers not well established, few sales steady to $1.00 per cwt lower, USDA said. Inquiry moderate, demand rather light. Sales confirmed on 600 slaughter steers and 700 slaughter heifers Thursday.
For the week to date 52,400 head confirmed including 8,600 head or about 16 percent prevously contracted or formulated cattle. Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter steers - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1260 lbs 67.00; Few Select with end Choice 1100-1125 lbs 67.00.
Slaughter heifers - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1260 lbs 67.00.
Wk to date - 52,400 last week - 27,300 last year - 74,500
